distribution.summary: Sichuan; Fujian; Anhui; Zhejiang; Guizhou; Yunnan; Taiwan; Henan; Hunan; Shanxi
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) records Sichuan (Emei Shan and Leibo) and Fujian (Nanping, Sanming and Yongchun). Huang & Lu (2015) additionally reports Anhui, Zhejiang, Guizhou and Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Taiwan and broad mainland China regions (CE, NO, SE, SW), which are not expanded into provinces. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Henan, Hunan, Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Baseline hosts Cunninghamia lanceolata and Sabina chinensis are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds genus-level Chamaecyparis, Juniperus, Thuja, Thujopsis, Cryptomeria and Cunninghamia; Chamaecyparis is explicitly recorded in Taiwan. Genus-level evidence is not expanded to species.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Phloeosinus perlatus Chapuis, 1876.

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows the integrated taxonomic backbone: Phloeosinus perlatus Chapuis, 1876. A previous profile record gave authorship Wood, 2007; that earlier display was inconsistent with the integrated backbone and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
